persons.name: Jakhaṃrāja
persons.evidence: sagaṇaparivārasya jakhaṃrājasya dhīmatāṃ | śu(bhadhaṃmam) alaṃbhūyāt yāvac caṃdradivākaraḥ || 〇 bhāro staṃ (!) nimihlina (!) śrīrājanītisa⁅mu⁆ccaya cānakyasārasaṃgrahaśāstra coyā

purpose: for Jakhaṃrāja Bhāro and his family (ārogyajanadhanalakṣmīsaṃtatisaṃtānavṛddhir astu)
notes: The catalogue mistakenly enters 'NS 605' under 'Place of Copying'. The opening verses mention a minister (maṃtrirāja), his brother, and a son ('tasyātmajaś ca'), but the names in those lines are obscured by meter/lacunae and are too fragmentary to identify securely apart from Jakhaṃrāja.
